svg.title: Laundry worker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as laundry worker, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: Two folded linen pieces sit above a tapered laundry basket with three open slats. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
